messages.subject: scale_shape_manual in dev-mode
parts:
Hello,

I just started to use the dev mode of ggplot
to create use a script provided by winston.

In my ggplot I also want to use manual
shapes for my points. Therefore I used in
ggplot following line:

scale_shape_manual(value=c(21,16))

Somehow this doesn't work with the dev-mode.
What are the correct parameters in the dev-mode?
What has changed?

Another question about the ggplot dev:
What is the corresponding function to
scale_y_log? This scale is based on e^x but
the scale_y_log10 has the base 10. All
my regressions where calculated just with
log and not with log10 so that now all the regression
lines are shifted...

/Thank you

Johannes

messages.author: 4fdc04b06b76c8cf
messages.subject: Re: scale_shape_manual in dev-mode
parts: Hi,

> > In my ggplot I also want to use manual
> > shapes for my points. Therefore I used in
> > ggplot following line:
> >
> > scale_shape_manual(value=c(21,16))
> >
> > Somehow this doesn't work with the dev-mode.
> > What are the correct parameters in the dev-mode?
> > What has changed?
>
> Please provide a minimal reproducible example.
>

Here some code:

pred.x1 <-runif(5, 5.0, 7.5)
pred.x2 <- runif(5,0.1,0.9)
pred.x3 <- runif(5,0,1000)
resp.y1 <- runif(5,1,10)
resp.y2 <- runif(5,30,50)

df1 <- data.frame(pred.x1,pred.x2,pred.x3,resp.y1,resp.y2)

########## grid arrange approach ###############

#reshape dataframe for this approach
df3 <-reshape2:::melt.data.frame(df1,id=c("pred.x1", "pred.x2", "pred.x3"),variable.name="resp.name",value.name="resp.value")


#create single plots, with scale_shape_manual

plot.grid3 <- ggplot(df3, aes(x=pred.x3,y=resp.value,shape=resp.name))+
geom_point()+
scale_x_log10(limits=range(df3$pred.x3))+
scale_y_log10("Response", limits=yrange, breaks=c(1,5,10,20,50),labels=c(1,5,10,20,50))+
scale_shape_manual(value=c(21,16))+
opts(legend.position = "none",
axis.title.x = theme_blank(),
axis.title.y = theme_blank(),
plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm")
)

> > Another question about the ggplot dev:
> > What is the corresponding function to
> > scale_y_log? This scale is based on e^x but
> > the scale_y_log10 has the base 10. All
> > my regressions where calculated just with
> > log and not with log10 so that now all the regression
> > lines are shifted...
>
> scale_y_continuous(trans = "log") IIRC

Thank you, thats what I was looking for.

Is there any time schedule when
these features will be moved from the dev mode to the official ggplot release?

/johannes
